sections.title: Project overview
sections.content: A bakery wants a website that lets customers browse the menu and place cake orders online, for local families and small offices in town who order celebration cakes for birthdays and other events.

sections.title: Key details
sections.content: Deliverables: menu page, online order form with checkout, contact page. Deadline: 2026-11-02. Budget: $3,000, already approved. Constraints: checkout goes through a third-party payment processor rather than a custom payment system; style is clean and minimal using the existing navy and cream logo colors.
